source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
With **GENESTEALER CULTS** as your [Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction), you begin the battle with Resurgence points set by [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size):

- **Incursion**: 6
- **Strike Force**: 10
- **Onslaught**: 14

Whenever a unit of yours is **destroyed**, if all its models other than **CHARACTER** models have this ability, you can pay Resurgence points by its [Starting Strength](vsdata:core-rule/units-and-models), not counting attached **CHARACTER** models:

- **Aberrants**: 4 for 5 models, 8 for 10.
- **Acolyte Hybrids with Autopistols**, **Acolyte Hybrids with Hand Flamers** and **Hybrid Metamorphs**: 2 for 5 models, 4 for 10.
- **Atalan Jackals**: 2 for 5 models, 6 for 10.
- **Neophyte Hybrids**: 3 for 10 models, 6 for 20.
- **Purestrain Genestealers**: 2 for 5 models, 6 for 10.

If you do:

- add to your army, in Cult Ambush, a copy of the destroyed unit without its **CHARACTER** models, at its Starting Strength and with every wound left; its **[[ONE SHOT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/one-shot)** weapons count as not yet shot
- place a Cult Ambush marker anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" horizontally from every enemy unit; if there is no such spot, place none

**Units in Cult Ambush**: these units are in a form of [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves). The [Rapid Ingress](vsdata:ability/core.rapid-ingress) Stratagem cannot target them. They can arrive through the markers described below, or by the Strategic Reserves rules in a later turn. They are not destroyed automatically as the third battle round ends.

**Cult Ambush Markers**: these are round 32mm markers. Whenever an enemy model, other than an **AIRCRAFT** model, ends any move up to 8" from one of your markers, remove that marker. As [your opponent's next Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) ends, each of your markers that remains on the battlefield lets you bring in a unit of yours from Cult Ambush with an [ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move), even during the first battle round. Set the unit up with one or more of its models in base contact with the marker and every other model wholly within 3" of it, then remove the marker.
